riverDescription: 340 m sinuous fresh-water river; complete isolated peak feet clear its banks

m4RockRelief.scope: Larger unequal planar block faces, shorter risers, restrained rounded knobs; full source terrain/mesh sampling resolution unchanged; fixed bare=1 decouples rock relief and bicubic correction from M4 vegetation potential
m4RockRelief.invarianceScope: terrSD gVeg=false volume export; canopy evaluation with gVeg=true still uses V

addedPass: FS_NATIVE_ANCHOR: 20% linear negative erosion, max 20% base/62m cut, convex crest protection, drainage channels preserved
terrainStructure: Small shared-foot mountain groups joined by finite curved variable-width saddles and descending side spurs, irregular low hills, preserved isolated peaks; one BASE/erosion/H/terrSD chain

landscape.supportContract: Finite curved swept-disc ridges and rotated low hills, minimum 48m outside river; no common flat base; same BASE/H/terrSD chain

ecologyPatch.material: Montane green-patch potential across shoulders and moist gullies; macro heightfield slope does not erase unresolved SDF shelves. Actual surface support rejects vertical faces during material/plant construction.
ecologyPatch.riparianForest: Retained lowland grove/clearing mosaic; compact montane tree candidates and dwarf shrub colonies follow the same V habitat fields
ecologyPatch.classification: Local 9m slope, 60m relative relief, aspect, convexity, flow and warped 35–150m patches; no absolute altitude vegetation band

vegetationContract.r: montane green-patch potential; retained lowland cover

ecologyPatch.rootSupport: Four crown-footprint height samples; smaller montane crowns and local relief budget; actual SDF surface reanchoring remains mandatory in the raster forest
ecologyPatch.transition: Continuous blend with retained lowland radii where relative-relief/slope mountain classification is between zero and one
ecologyPatch.geometrySemantics: M4 rock wrapper fixes terrSD bare=1, so exported gVeg=false rock geometry is independent of this V potential. Base height/76 peak layout and all sampling resolutions remain unchanged.

idlePatch.scope: Independent native startDrone CPU scheduling only; all GLSL and the preserved source renderer remain unchanged

treeRootSupport: Four crown-footprint samples at radius R*1.2; reject >6.5..11m relief, shared lowland grove/clearing mosaic

globalDeclarationRelocation.name: gHz
globalDeclarationRelocation.reason: Allow nested fogApply state save/restore; atmosphere function body unchanged

riverPatch.reflection: One real march + unchanged shadeScene + unchanged fogApply; same source skyView for sky misses. No terrainCheap brightness cap, no recursive water.
riverPatch.waterGeometry: Shared analytic 12-wave height/gradient and shared grazing-correct footprint for intersection and shading, at unchanged 0.75 quiet amplitude, with conservative-slab bracketed Newton intersection; peak envelope 0.039165m < 0.065m at uOAmp<=2.

waveSampling.footprint: max(0.001, t*2*uTan/uRes.y) / max(-rd.y,0.02), shared by waterHit and shadeWater
waveSampling.directionDistribution: First three long waves keep the existing wind directions; remaining nine advance by the golden angle 2.39996323 radians
waveSampling.zeroWeightWork: Return exact zero beyond the longest-wave filter cutoff; skip each exact-zero filter before wave direction/dispersion/phase evaluation
waveSampling.bedDetail: Unchanged base screen-pixel footprint, without grazing correction

riverPatch.transmission: Snell ray intersects actual Hc bed through at most eight brackets and ten bisections, then uses Hc normal, code-only wet-silt albedo and per-metre two-way attenuation.
riverPatch.freshwaterBed: New seaFloor function only: ~0.20m irregular wet foot to a 4-8m along-channel/transverse alluvial bed; no inherited Pacific reef/cove coordinates or shelf terms.
riverPatch.marineEffects: Disabled at all live water entries; inherited unreachable helper definitions remain for transparent source provenance.
riverPatch.performance: Reflection retains one extra full land/crown/shadow shade. The bed uses <=18 bracket/bisection Hc lookups instead of the full scene/SDF/tree marcher; actual cost requires hidden GPU measurement. No FPS promise.
riverPatch.knownApproximation: skyView retains the source uRo-based cloud origin; clouds are distant, while reflected land/crowns use the true water-surface ray origin.

cpuReservedDeclarationCheck.scope: Static declaration check, not GPU compilation

peakSearch.outsideAggregate: Jump to ray entry or downward y60 boundary; upward empty sky exits immediately.

marchPatch.rationale: A conservative max-slope distance bounds travel but does not prove surface proximity.
marchPatch.activeIteration: Only environment sceneSD visits increment the epsilon index; pure high-air H samples keep tolerances unchanged. Total gIt and 3000-step budget are retained.
marchPatch.primaryWaterOrder: Test the same physical water surface first, cap primary terrain traversal at it, preserve real above-water occlusion and avoid marching the submerged bed twice.
marchPatch.groundHit: Only gentle dry lowland retains the source correction; high, steep or submerged candidates use directional secant/Newton seeks a positive/negative sceneSD bracket, safeguarded secant contracts it, final exact point refreshes all source material state.
marchPatch.primaryTrees: On gentle ground original source acceptance retained. On steep terrain original three correction steps and crown/branch/leaf geometry retained; actual acceptance capped at 0.45 pixel independent of iteration count. Any final switch to ground requires the terrain sign bracket.
marchPatch.negativeEntry: Bracket from the last tested exterior ray point; exponential backtracking is a fallback when no exterior point was supplied.
marchPatch.exhaustion: No invented hit on march/refinement budget exhaustion.
marchPatch.shaderCompiler: One additional sceneSD call site in a non-unrolled state loop.

airAcceleration.reason: Experimental max-height air traversal did not improve the fixed-view actual frame time; retained behind --air-accel for comparison.

postWhiteBalance: Uniform linear camera tint, identity at default zero temperature

portraitCamera.method: Render a real portrait viewport with its own camera framing; no post-crop or stretched wide frame.

flightHeightMetres.note: Final low river composition is deliberately lower than the main flight.
